notes: Per-suite ACT policies trained from scratch on official LIBERO training data (lerobot ACTConfig, chunk_size=100, no pretrained backbone). An earlier gripper-sign-inversion bug in action post-processing (fixed before this run) is documented in docs/act-libero-EVAL_REPORT.md section 4.
